data.text: Ran the checklist against 0.7.0 as it was written, and it caught something on the first pass: dist/reference.json was missing, because a rebuild wipes dist and only npm run reference puts it back. That is the exact item the list exists for - the file the site takes as committed, which nothing rebuilds for you and nothing tests. Also verified the real-size case properly: board --json --limit 0 is 189 KB through a pipe and arrives whole, which is over the 128 KiB that used to truncate.
